content.name: Grace Mensah
content.title: IT Support Team Lead
content.summary: IT support lead with 16 years in Ottawa, from help desk to running a bilingual service desk of six for a 450-person engineering firm. Raised customer satisfaction from 3.9 to 4.6 out of 5 and halved the ticket backlog within a year. Experienced with privacy-sensitive environments, including a medical imaging clinic and a credit union.

experience.title: Help Desk Technician
bullets: Answered phone and email support for 140 staff in 20 residential buildings, closing about 300 tickets a month.
Imaged and deployed desktops for the building offices, standardizing on one Windows 7 build.
Kept the asset register accurate across all sites, which made the first hardware refresh possible to budget properly.

experience.title: Desktop Support Analyst
bullets: Supported radiologists and technologists on PACS viewing stations, where downtime directly delayed patient reports.
Brought average response time for clinical workstation faults down to 15 minutes by keeping pre-imaged spares on each floor.
Encrypted every laptop and enforced screen locks as part of the clinic's PHIPA privacy program.
Wrote the after-hours support guide used by the on-call technologist team.

experience.title: Senior IT Support Specialist
bullets: Acted as escalation point for 11 branches and head office, handling the hardest 15% of tickets.
Led the Windows 10 and Office 365 migration for 230 staff over a single summer with no branch closing early.
Set up remote access and laptops for 150 staff within two weeks in March 2020.
Ran quarterly phishing simulations with the security officer; click rates fell from 19% to 6%.

experience.title: IT Support Team Lead
bullets: Lead a team of six support analysts serving 450 staff in English and French across three offices.
Cut the ticket backlog from 410 to 190 in twelve months through daily stand-ups, triage rules and a self-service portal.
Raised post-ticket satisfaction from 3.9 to 4.6 out of 5 while volume grew about 20%.
Manage a $220,000 annual budget for end-user hardware, licences and support contracts.

education.degree: Ontario College Diploma, Computer Systems Technician

courses.name: ITIL 4 Managing Professional: Create, Deliver and Support

achievements.title: Service excellence award, Gatineau Hills Engineering
achievements.detail: Recognised by the leadership team for the backlog turnaround in 2023.

achievements.title: Volunteer, newcomer tech skills workshops
achievements.detail: Teach monthly sessions on online banking safety at an Ottawa settlement agency.
